Origin and meaning

With Latin origins, Dominic is usually read as “of the Lord”.

About the name Dominic

Saint Dominic founded the Dominican order in the 13th century.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Dominic carries the meaning “of the Lord” and looks striking in brush strokes.
